title: Rooftop timelapse at dusk
idea: timelapse from a rooftop as the city goes from dusk to night
style: clean digital cinema, blue hour palette shifting to warm sodium and LED
subject: a dense city skyline with a river, a bridge and traffic on the embankment
setting: a rooftop terrace with a low parapet in the foreground, late evening
light: blue hour sky as key fading to night; building windows and street lights switching on

beats.action: timelapse: clouds streak across a deep blue sky, the last orange on the horizon fades
beats.camera: locked-off wide, parapet in the lower third

beats.action: windows light up across the skyline one block at a time
traffic on the bridge becomes streaks of red and white
full night; the river reflects the lights; a plane crosses the sky

physics: timelapse motion: clouds streak, shadows sweep, traffic blurs into streaks; the buildings stay perfectly still

sound.ambience: distant city hum, wind on the rooftop

notes: 12 s needs a multi-shot or long-clip model; the check command flags the length on Veo, Wan and Runway.
